sqlserver.description: SQL Server MCP for EscrowApp database exploration. Connection string must be set via ESCROW_DB_CONNECTION_STRING environment variable — never hardcode credentials.

postgres.description: PostgreSQL MCP server for EscrowApp. This project uses Npgsql/PostgreSQL as its primary data store. Set ESCROW_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING env var to connect.

telegram.description: Telegram MCP server — read/send messages, manage chats via MTProto userbot. Run 'npx @overpod/mcp-telegram login' first to authenticate via QR code.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp MCP bridge — read/search/send messages. Requires Go bridge running separately: 'cd whatsapp-bridge && go run main.go' then scan QR code.
